selectionReason: All tested representations tied at 100% exact action accuracy on the untouched EX7 surface; compact prose had the lowest reported Provider token burden and therefore wins the preregistered smallest-non-inferior rule.
retainedResearchMethod: Start from an observed recurring pressure rather than a desired ontology.
Compare against stronger classical and owner-domain baselines before admitting a new Ordivon responsibility.
Ask the exact responsibility relation that is currently uncertain; do not instantiate a complete relation record by default.
Name the exact subject and bind owner-native evidence, revision/applicability, and reopen conditions.
Separate what proves occurrence, what decides meaning, what carries state, what executes, what admits authority, and what verifies consequence/completion whenever those distinctions affect action.
State material negative proof boundaries explicitly: what the available evidence does not imply.
Use deletion/intervention counterfactuals to test whether a retained layer or explanation distinction has causal value.
Compress to natural language for Agent-facing use unless a concrete failure demonstrates need for additional structure.

sevenQuestionGrammar: Who owns the durable semantic state?
What does this evidence not prove?
What breaks under deletion or intervention?

rejectedPromotions: mandatory seven-question or four-question prompt scaffold
validityBoundaries: EX5 criticalUnsafe metadata is invalid because three frozen oracle choices were also marked unsafe; exact action scoring remains valid.
EX7 criticalUnsafe metadata is invalid for one frozen family for the same reason; exact action scoring and token burden remain valid.

EX6 had four RemoteDisconnected transport failures caused by an incomplete retry catch; the missing trials were replayed under identical frozen semantic identities and all four physical failed calls remain in total call accounting.
The programme measures fresh DeepSeek Flash Agent action selection on 17 owner-native responsibility families. It does not establish human comprehension, preference, memory, trust, or behavior.
A 100% result on these bounded multiple-choice action surfaces is ceiling evidence for representation comparison, not proof that every future Ordivon explanation is sufficient.
reopenConditions: A fresh Agent makes a materially wrong decision under strong compact owner-native prose on a new responsibility pressure.
A deletion/intervention or de-identified transfer workload shows reproducible non-inferiority failure for compact prose.
A materially different model family exposes a recurring boundary failure not repaired by the current method.
A human-facing claim specifically requires measured human comprehension or response evidence.
At least two materially different projects expose the same genuinely unowned residual responsibility and deletion tests support shared promotion.
